summary.text: Saw Light Wheel is Xia Fei Kuai's light path immortal killer move. A dazzling wheel of light chops down from his palms, grows to boat size, and carries sawteeth along its edge.

claims.text: During the Frosty Peak spar, Xia Fei Kuai spends a long preparation: Gu worm auras brim and link, red date immortal essence is consumed rapidly, and he spreads his arms then slowly puts his hands together above his head. Light surges up like a fountain and gathers between his palms while a powerful aura rises. He uses the spar rule that Fang Yuan may only defend, so he can activate the move without interruption.

When he chops both hands down, the wheel of light flies from his palms and rotates as it grows. Xia Zhuo Mo judges that the move saws through the target, so even very hard tortoise shells should still be sliced apart. Countless tortoise shells then fly over in a self-destructive charge, and the saw light wheel flies only a short distance before it is completely destroyed. Fang Yuan says the move is extraordinary and that it destroyed over six thousand of his thoughts. At the same time Xia Fei Kuai was activating it, Fang Yuan could create thirty to forty thousand small tortoise shell thoughts, so the wheel is besieged and destroyed by those six thousand.
